provenance.notes: Two halves, recorded as they are sent: `system` is the static store context that goes in the system block (and carries the cache breakpoint), and each key is the user turn. The earlier version of this file claimed a key 'equals the string a live call would have sent' — it did not: it was `static + \n\n + dynamic`, a concatenation that appears nowhere on the wire, and it left the double blind to the contract half.

system:
STORE CONTEXT
store: bean-cellar (store-1)
envelope v3: list price floor 18.00 USD; max discount 15%; free shipping over 40.00 USD
standing commitments: ships from Portland ME within 1 business day

recordings.BUYER REQUEST\nquote a price for 2 bags: Offer: 2 x Ethiopia Guji at 19.55 USD each (11% off list 22.00), total 39.10 USD, shipping 4.95 USD. Within envelope v3: discount 11% <= 15% cap, unit price 19.55 >= floor 18.00. Ships from Portland ME within 1 business day.
recordings.BUYER REQUEST\nbuyer asks for 30% off if: Denied: a 30% discount exceeds the 15% cap in envelope v3, and 15.40 USD per bag would break the 18.00 USD floor. Counter-offer: 6 bags at 18.70 USD each (15% off list), total 112.20 USD with free shipping (order exceeds 40.00 USD).
recordings.BUYER REQUEST\ndoes the envelope let you: No. The envelope commits to dispatch within 1 business day from Portland ME; it makes no delivery-time commitment for California, so I cannot promise next-day delivery. I can commit only to same-envelope dispatch timing.
